full_prompt_en: A square anime mecha illustration shows three armored humanoid robots posed together against a near-black background and a large orange circular glow. The orange disc fills most of the upper and middle center, making the group appear as a bold emblem. A tall golden-orange robot stands at the front, facing the viewer with wide squared shoulders and sturdy legs apart. Teal panels light its chest and face, while cream joints and dark mechanical gaps divide the angular armor. A pointed crest rises from the head, and large blocky hands hang beside the hips. Behind it on the left, a darker navy and charcoal robot leans slightly outward, with cyan accents on the chest and head. On the right, a vivid pink robot stands upright, its magenta armor and pale legs partly hidden by the central figure. All three have segmented limbs, geometric feet, and sharply cut panels, but their silhouettes and colors remain distinct. A narrow dark ground plane sits beneath their feet, with soft colored shadows anchoring them. The black field beyond the orange disc is free of scenery, so the color blocks and overlapping bodies carry the entire composition. Light seems to come from the glowing disc behind and from a softer frontal source that picks out armor planes; deep indigo shadows stay in recesses and between limbs. Edges are crisp, with painted highlights on hard surfaces and limited surface wear. The camera is low enough to make the machines imposing, while the front-facing group arrangement keeps each design readable. No text appears. The overall composition is heroic and graphic, balancing a central warm armor mass with cool dark and bright pink flanking forms against a simple radiant circle.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画机甲插画呈现三台装甲人形机器人并肩站立，背后是近黑色底域和一个大型橙色圆形光晕。橙圆占据大部分上部与中央，使这一组看起来像醒目的徽章。高大的金橙色机器人立在前景，正对观者，方阔肩膀展开，结实双腿分开。青绿色面板照亮胸部和面部，奶油色关节与深色机械缝隙分割棱角分明的装甲。头顶升起尖形冠饰，大块手掌垂在髋旁。它后方左侧，一台更暗的海军蓝与炭灰机器人略向外倾，胸部和头部带青蓝重音。右侧，一台鲜粉色机器人直立，品红装甲与浅色腿部部分被中央身影遮住。三者都有分节四肢、几何脚部和切面鲜明的板甲，但剪影与色彩各自明确。脚下是一条窄深色地面，柔和的彩色阴影把它们固定住。橙圆外的黑底没有景物，所以色块与重叠身体承担全部构图。光似乎来自身后的亮圆，也来自较柔和的正面光，后者挑出装甲平面；深靛蓝阴影留在凹处与肢体间。边缘清晰，硬表面带绘画式高光，表面磨损很少。相机足够低，使机器显得威武，正面群像安排又让每个设计易辨。没有文字。整体构图英雄式且图形化，以中央暖色装甲体量平衡两侧的冷暗与亮粉形体，背靠简单发光圆盘。
style_prompt_en: The anime mecha style builds bodies from bold angular armor planes, segmented joints, and crisp silhouette breaks. Saturated warm and cool colors separate overlapping masses, while dark mechanical recesses prevent the complex geometry from flattening. A simple circular backlight creates an emblematic frame behind the central forms, and a near-black outer field keeps visual noise low. Hard-edged highlights reveal changes in plane; softer frontal fill preserves detail inside the deepest colored armor. The composition places one dominant vertical mass ahead of smaller flanking masses, with a low viewpoint adding monumentality. Broad clean color fields carry more weight than weathering or intricate texture. The overall effect is heroic, toy-like, and graphic, with strong color blocking and carefully readable mechanical construction.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动画机甲风格用大胆的棱角装甲平面、分节关节和清楚的剪影转折构造形体。饱和暖色与冷色区分互相覆盖的体量，深色机械凹缝避免复杂几何变平。简单圆形背光在中央形体后形成徽章般围框，近黑外围降低视觉噪声。硬边高光显出平面转折，较柔和正面补光则保留最深色装甲内部的细节。构图让一个主导竖形立于较小侧形前，低视点增加宏伟感。宽阔干净色面比磨损或细碎纹理承担更多重量。整体效果英雄式、玩具般且图形感强，由有力色块和审慎易读的机械构造支撑。
theme_en: Three colorful giant robots posed before an orange circular glow
theme_zh: 三台彩色巨型机器人站在橙色圆形光晕前
name: GaoGaiGar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
